gpt-oss-20b.notes: Validated main model (2026-04-05 harness). Shipped OpenCode limit 108000.

gpt-oss-120b.notes: Validated main model (2026-04-05) at gpu_memory_utilization 0.80 with the utility model coexisting. Combined GPU budget on this host is ~0.94 total; above that, switch to exclusive.

gemma4-26b-a4b.notes: Runs on the local vllm-node-tf5-gemma4 overlay image (newer Transformers pin; tensor_parallel stays 1 on this host). The startup compile spike needs /swap.img plus RAY_memory_usage_threshold=0.99. Image input and tool calling validated on the gateway. Soaks pass to ~243k prompt tokens once max_completion_tokens is 1024+. Thinking works but eats the completion budget. Client ceiling 240000.

gemma4-31b.notes: Does not work - hangs. Either too long to answer or has problems.

huihui-gemma4-e2b-abliterated.notes: Abliterated google/gemma-4-E2B-it on the vllm-node-tf5-gemma4 image. Native 131072 context. Text, tool calling, and image input validated; no separate reasoning block. Client ceiling 120000 until soaked.

glm-4.7-flash-awq.notes: Validated main model (2026-04-05). Local TF5 image with the GLM 4.7 speed patch and MLA weight-guard fix. 131072 context, 5-way concurrency at gpu_memory_utilization 0.70 with the utility model loaded. Shipped OpenCode limit 108000.

dolphin-mistral-24b-venice-fp8.notes: Needs the dolphin_mistral tool parser plugin and the vendored Mistral parallel tool template. Tool calling validated direct and via gateway.

nemotron-3-nano-30b-nvfp4.notes: Needs non-thinking defaults for visible output (the validator applies them). Soaks pass to ~112k prompt tokens; ~116k is borderline. Client ceiling 110000.

qwen3.5-0.8b.notes: Utility helper for titles and lightweight classification (scitrera.ai SGLang recipe). mem-fraction-static 0.05 and 32768 context so it coexists with main models; 0.06 expands memory counterproductively.

qwen3.6-27b-fp8.notes: Mirror of Spark Arena's qwen3.6-27b-fp8-vllm recipe on the repo TF5 image. Text, tools, and thinking validated on the gateway; non-thinking by default. Client ceiling 240000 (a ~249k probe left one token of completion headroom).

qwen3.6-27b-fp8-mtp.notes: qwen3.6-27b-fp8 plus upstream MTP speculative decoding (num_speculative_tokens=2). Thinking with tools works but needs a large completion budget. Client ceiling 240000.

qwen3.6-35b-a3b-opus-distilled.notes: Distilled reasoning lane; non-thinking by default like the other Qwen 3.6 lanes. The checkpoint can omit the closing </think>, so the compose path loads the qwen3_opus_distilled fallback parser (streaming included).

qwen3.6-35b-a3b-fp8.notes: Mirror of Spark Arena's qwen3.6-35b-a3b-fp8-vllm recipe on the TF5 image, tuned to gpu_memory_utilization 0.84 (utility model still fits). 5-way soak passes at ~238k prompt tokens; ~29 tok/s single-user. The 0.84 envelope diverges from the upstream 0.80.

qwen3.6-35b-a3b-fp8-mtp.notes: MTP variant of qwen3.6-35b-a3b-fp8 (same 0.84 envelope). On the ~238k soak, MTP cut average request time from 87.6s to 37.2s and raised throughput from 9.0 to 16.9 tok/s.

huihui-qwen3.6-27b-abliterated.notes: BF16 abliterated Qwen3.6-27B on a dedicated TF5 image (pinned transformers plus a w8a8_utils guard for the qwen3_5 model type). Conservative eager single-GPU profile. Chat, tools, and reasoning_effort=high validated; non-thinking control must go through chat_template_kwargs because the checkpoint's top-level thinking flag is broken.

huihui-qwen3.6-35b-a3b-claude-4.7-opus-a.notes: Same conservative abliterated-Qwen runtime shape as the 27B; reuses the qwen3_opus_distilled fallback parser (also promotes bare answers and raw <tool_call> markup out of the reasoning channel). 5-way soak passes at ~253k prompt tokens with a 512-token completion budget (256 truncates).

qwen3.5-122b-a10b-int4-autoround.notes: AutoRound int4 on the TF5 track (Raphael Amorim's recipe shape; vendored rope-validation patch instead of a startup network fetch). Hidden reasoning ate visible answers, so the validator applies non-thinking defaults. Keep exclusive until coexistence is validated.

huihui-qwen3.5-35b-a3b-abliterated.notes: TF5 image (the standard track hits a Torch Inductor autotune failure on this host). Non-thinking defaults required for visible answers; tools and image input validated. Soaks clean to ~250k prompt tokens, but long-context reads drift toward generic advice. OpenCode ceiling 200000; ~250000 practical manual ceiling.

jackrong-qwen3.5-35b-a3b-claude-4.6-opus.notes: Runs with the Qwen3.5-0.8B chat template (bundled one swapped out), the qwen3_opus_distilled reasoning parser, and --language-model-only (the checkpoint lacks image processor files). Chat, reasoning_effort=high, and tools validated; 5-way soak passes at ~253k prompt tokens with a 512-token completion budget.

qwen3-coder-next-int4-autoround.notes: 1M-context AutoRound int4 (Bjarke Bolding's recipe shape, Yarn rope scaling, vendored reverse patch for the gate quantization regression). Minimal 5-way retention probe clean to ~524k prompt tokens, but the richer soak prompt loops even at low context and near-1M tiers are impractically slow. Practical ceiling ~524000.

qwen2.5-1.5b-instruct.notes: Former utility helper; kept as an experimental small-text fallback.
